title: One day training programme on “Stepping forward to promote the safety of medical devices: Materiovigilance Program of India"
bodyHtml:
NCC-MvPI, IPC in association with Royal Care Super Speciality Hospital (RCSSH), Coimbatore is conducting one day training programme on “Stepping forward to promote the safety of medical devices: Materiovigilance Program of India” at Royal Care Super Speciality Hospital (RCSSH), Coimbatore on 16th February, 2024.
